generator: manual authoring from kb/baselines/*.json major_classes rows (no fuzzy matching)
purpose: Candidate-set exclusion prior: which KB classes are legitimate for a tissue. Used ONLY as a hard set filter before candidate assembly when EYEKB_TISSUE_SCOPE=1. This table is NOT a score, weight, confidence bonus or ranking term, and must never be consumed as one.
red_line_note: kb/baselines usage_redline forbids composition numbers feeding scores. This table carries class NAMES only (no percentages), so no composition quantity enters scoring. PI authorized 2026-10-20 ('补').
mapping_policy: Explicit, withdrawable, with baseline_row provenance. No name-similarity inference. excluded_classes is authored per tissue and lists ONLY clearly foreign signature identities; classes that could be contamination are never banned from naming (contamination is a QC flag). A tissue with inventory_status=absent gets a coarse foreign-identity guard only — that guard is NOT an inventory and must not be reported as one.

classes.basis: KB has both Microglia and Micro panels for the same compartment

retina.also_allowed_note: Vascular/immune/mural classes (Endo, Pericyte, Fibroblast, SMC, T, B, NK, Plasma, Mono_*, Mac_*, cDC1, cDC2, pDC, Granulocyte, Proliferating) are present in retina sections in vivo but the retina baseline row set does not enumerate them; they stay OUT of the hard whitelist and are controlled by allow_non_baseline_classes (default true) so the filter only removes clearly foreign ocular-adnexa families.
retina.excluded_reason: ocular surface / corneal identities are foreign to neural retina; contamination, if any, is a QC flag not an identity

filter_rule: candidates are excluded iff their base class appears in this tissue's excluded_classes. The inventory classes list is informational (and the strict-mode whitelist when strict_whitelist=true); classes simply absent from the inventory are NOT excluded, because absence from a 10-row baseline is not evidence of absence in tissue.
